notes: REVISE. Phan sua theo review cua codex thi tot va da dong. Nhung yeu cau thu hai - chuan hoa project_inputs cua ba grammar ve 38.3 m x 12.0 m - khong duoc dong den, va do moi la thu dang chan ca lo trinh. Ly do phai chuan hoa, khong phai chuyen thu tuc: ba ho nay la CAC LOAI KET CAU THAY THE cho CUNG MOT bai toan; so mot dam I nhip 35 m voi mot dam hop nhip 40 m khong phai nghien cuu chon loai cau, ma la hai bai toan khac nhau. Giu mot design basis duy nhat chinh la dieu lam cho buoc so sanh loai cau ve sau co nghia. Sau khi doi span, PHAI kiem lai he qua hinh hoc va bao cao trung thuc: ty so L/H doi, va neu FAB-007 (span-depth) nay noi o muc SOFT thi ghi ro ra chu KHONG duoc chinh nguong de che.
